steps.text: Each card at the top of the page shows one role. A card with the name of a person shows the role of that person.
Click the card to open the role details. Remove Role and Complete Other are only for Leia.
Click Complete Other. Type the name of the action, then select it. You can select any action.
Click Complete or Exempt. Then give the details, as for all other requirements.
To remove the role from Leia, click Remove Role. Select a reason, and type a comment.
Click Remove Role, then click Remove Role again. The other persons in the family keep their roles.
Host Family is a role for all the family. On this card, Complete Other records an action for all the family.
Under Family Members, Remove from role removes one person from the role. To record a requirement for one person, click the requirement.
The menu at the top right also has Remove from Host Family role and Complete other, for all the family.
